evidence_notes.execution_semantics: Document provider close-observation construction, decision cutoff, timezone, corporate-action handling, exact per-symbol official-session endpoints, and the valuation-return/non-executable-trade-return interpretation. Unadjusted open and nonfill semantics belong to a later portfolio module.
evidence_notes.tradability_fields: Show non-degenerate ST and suspension behavior under historically effective vendor definitions. Price-limit, missing-open, and nonfill evidence is required only for a later portfolio module and does not authorize that unimplemented module.
evidence_notes.exact_endpoint_resolution: Verify before design freeze that every active-master identifier carrying a signal-session quote also carries exact t, t+1, t+20, and t+21 provider close observations. For each signal-eligible record, any unresolved endpoint receives one of the three fixed reason codes; next quotes, reopening prices, researcher-generated last-price carry-forward, and default recoveries are forbidden. The delisting-terminal-wealth adapter remains unimplemented.
evidence_notes.suspension_valuation_semantics: Cite provider documentation and delivery evidence showing close_observation_type is traded_close exactly when is_suspended is false and suspension_valuation exactly when is_suspended is true; every suspension valuation must be recorded or published by the supplier for that exact official session, never generated by research-code forward-fill. Both observation types must occur among the fixed signal-session candidates.
evidence_notes.price_adjustment_semantics: Bind three distinct evidence hashes: the provider definition of close_raw for traded and suspended sessions, the provider definition of its cumulative corporate-action factor and hfq convention, and the exact private normalization/adapter record. Verify mechanically that every row carries the exact fixed method and convention tokens and that close equals close_raw times a finite positive adjustment_factor within 1e-12 relative and absolute tolerances. The factor is used as delivered without rebasing; multiplying one symbol's full factor history by a positive constant leaves its return ratios unchanged, and cross-sectional price levels are not estimands.
evidence_notes.amount_unit_normalization: Cite the provider field dictionary and private adapter or supplier transformation record showing the provider-native amount unit, the exact conversion into CNY, the cutoff timing, and the resulting canonical amount_unit=CNY before the quote bytes were hashed. This attestation does not treat the public repository as proof that any production provider conversion has been executed.
evidence_notes.endpoint_reason_ledger_rights: Confirm that the complete per-security endpoint-reason ledger may be retained privately and hash-bound in the result receipt, and that aggregate reason-code counts may be published without redistributing licensed rows.
evidence_notes.historical_membership_completeness: Cite a provider field dictionary, extraction manifest, and completeness evidence showing every strict SH/SZ A-share active at any time from January 2009 through January 2023, including delisted securities; a latest-only security list is insufficient.
evidence_notes.terminal_survivor_comparator: Verify that A0 uses the fixed terminal cutoff 2023-01-31: a security is a terminal survivor only when delistDate is null or strictly after that date, while listDate must still be on or before each signal session. The extraction-time listStatus and acquisition date do not redefine the comparator; lifecycle status/date consistency must already pass.
evidence_notes.security_identifier_semantics: Cite the provider identifier definition and a separate code-change mapping record. Confirm that the exact token provider_stable_exchange_qualified_security_identifier_with_reviewed_code_change_mapping_v1 describes identical identifier semantics in quotes, stock_master, and fundamentals, and that every historical code change or reassignment is resolved before the four canonical files are hash-bound. This is an identifier contract, not a vintage claim.
evidence_notes.fundamental_publication_semantics: Cite the provider mapping proving that roeDiluted maps one-to-one into decimal-unit roe and publishDate is the actual recorded disclosure date, not a scheduled, appointment, update, ingestion, or revision timestamp.
evidence_notes.data_rights: Record the exact SHA-256 of the completed private stage2_data_rights_attestation_v2 file after validating its contract and license evidence for local analysis, public aggregate outputs, metadata, hashes, exact official-calendar dates, private-ledger retention, controlled reviewer rerun, source-identity publication, and field-mapping citation for every required dataset. For each of the four roles, the packet must authorize and hash the exact source name and complete canonical-to-provider field mapping, and those projections must exactly match data_declaration.dataset_source_mappings. Generic approval text, missing or extra fields, role swaps, hash mismatches, or projection differences fail closed. The runner requires that same private file and recomputes this binding before authorization is consumed.
evidence_notes.official_calendar: Retain authoritative SSE/SZSE provenance, resolve any disagreement, verify all endpoint and quote-date membership rules, and bind the exact CSV bytes.

chronology_contract.timezone_rule: Every timestamp must be finite ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset.
chronology_contract.mutation_rule: Any input-byte or evidence change after reviewed_at invalidates this attestation and requires a new review and hash.

signature.trust_boundary: Identity and evidence authenticity require independent human verification.

completion_gate: All required booleans, including exact-endpoint, supplier-recorded suspension-valuation, mechanically verified fixed adjusted-close formula/convention with three provider-definition/normalization evidence hashes, provider-amount normalization into canonical CNY before binding, endpoint-ledger-rights, complete historical-membership, fixed 2023-01-31 terminal-survivor comparator, provider-stable cross-input identifier semantics and documented code-change mapping, and fundamental-publication-semantics assertions, must be true; all hashes must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; all identities and timestamps must be complete; and status must become reviewed_pass before this artifact may enter the plan core.
